entries.name: nested-box-register-deserialize-v6-accept#22
entries.description: sigmaProp(ExtractAmount(box) == 1L), where the Box constant's R4 is the Tuple expression (DeserializeContext[Boolean](5), 1). The JVM parses it with hasDeserialize = true: the nested box's registers are read outside the nested tree's save and restore of the reader's flag (ErgoTreeSerializer.scala:160-168). So the spend goes through reductionWithDeserialize: the 54-byte tree's 108, plus 3. Valid at 12211. The input spends a box of value 1000000000 into one output of the same value. The initial cost is 12100; 'limit L' is maxBlockCost = 12100 + L, the input's remaining limit.
